Feature.DisplayName: Hamilton Microlab STARlet and DryLab4 Robotic Laboratory Bridge
Feature.Description: SiLA 2 compliant interface for Hamilton Microlab STARlet liquid handling automation, DryLab4 chromatography retention-time prediction bridge, Waters Empower / Agilent OpenLab CDS acquisition, and 432 Hz master clock synchronization.

Command.Description: Initializes the Hamilton Microlab STARlet deck carriers, tip racks, and waste positions according to the designated liquid class and layout.

Parameter.Description: Path or configuration identifier for the STARlet deck layout.

Response.Description: Status message confirming deck initialization and home sensor calibration.

Command.Description: Automates the preparation of chromatography sample vials, multi-solvent gradient blends, and internal standard spiking driven by DryLab4 optimization parameters.

Parameter.Description: JSON payload specifying compound parameters, target concentrations, gradient steps, and vial allocations.

Response.Description: Total number of HPLC sample vials prepared and loaded into autosampler rack.

Command.Description: Dispatches injection commands to HPLC autosampler and initiates Empower or OpenLab CDS acquisition sequence.

Parameter.Description: Volume in microliters to be injected onto the analytical column.

Response.Description: Unique tracking identifier assigned to the chromatographic acquisition run.

Command.Description: Retrieves processed peak tables, retention times, and spectra from Waters Empower or Agilent OpenLab CDS.

Parameter.Description: Unique tracking identifier for the chromatographic acquisition.

Response.Description: Extracted peak table, retention times, peak areas, and resolution metrics.

Command.Description: Calculates solvatochromic linear solvent strength (LSS) retention times for analyte mixtures across multi-dimensional parameter spaces.

Parameter.Description: Solvent gradient, column dimensions, temperature, and compound parameters.

Response.Description: Calculated retention times, peak widths, and critical resolution values.

Property.Description: Current operational state of the STARlet liquid handler and connected analytical instruments.
Operational telemetry of the 432 Hz UTC-disciplined master clock and IEEE 1588 PTP sync status.
